title: release-publishing runbook still says publish-release.sh resolves the run attempt
description: Noted by the LCLI-578 implementer on opum-ai/lore-cli#269. The paragraph in docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md just before the new receipt-gate paragraph says the script resolves the run attempt. That stopped being true with LCLI-487: artifact names dropped run_attempt, and the script matches both shapes. Correct the sentence to what the script does now.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The runbook sentence describes the current artifact-name matching, verified against scripts/publish-release.sh

finalSummary: docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md no longer says publish-release.sh resolves the run attempt. It now says what the script does, verified against scripts/publish-release.sh (the LCLI-487 comment at ~305, ensure_artifacts, verify_platform_digests) and release.yml's overwrite: true: npm-packages is downloaded by its fixed name; no attempt is resolved, because artifacts carry the run id alone since LCLI-487; the qualification reports match ladybug-package-qualification-*-<run-id>*, which also catches pre-2026-09-14 -<run-id>-<attempt> names; and more than one match for a platform is refused with both named. A sweep of 87 files in docs/ and README.md for the old phrasing found no other copies. bun run lore check: 82 files, 0 errors, exit 0. Delivered in the LCLI-587 PR (opum-ai/lore-cli, branch lcli-587-runbook-run-attempt).
